text:
The bowl looks like a large mixing bowl, roughly 30 cm across at the rim and about 22 cm across the inside of the base. That is large enough to hold a big pile of chopped chicken.

The chicken covers about 45% of the bowl floor and is piled 4-5 cm deep. I estimate about 300 g.

The creamy dressing, probably a mayo or hummus-like sauce, is a dollop about 8 cm across and 2-3 cm high. I estimate about 120 g.

There are about 8 cherry tomatoes visible, at roughly 17 g each, which gives about 130 g.

The shredded carrot is a small patch of about 30 g.

The red onion slices add about 15 g.
